projectPurpose: Public historical Australian Football (AFL/VFL) statistics database: Next.js App Router web application over PostgreSQL, with deterministic natural-language search, a Grid Solver, an admin surface, and a large repeatable import/enrichment toolchain.

uiSurface.captureNote: No browser MCP is granted. Visual evidence is captured by driving the repository's own Playwright install (playwright.config.ts, playwright.nl-stress.config.ts, playwright.admin-nav.config.ts) via npx, which is the leaner path and is already proven by tests/nl-ui/ and tests/admin-nav/.
uiSurface.viewportNote: Desktop > tablet > phone is this project's established breakpoint ordering.

apiSurface.note: Seven Next.js route handlers under src/app/api. There is no OpenAPI or GraphQL SDL in the repository, so regen-registry extracts the network contract from the route/handler definitions themselves. Server Actions ('use server' modules) are a second externally-reachable surface and are extracted alongside them.

typescript.note: Exported symbol extraction over .ts/.tsx via the TypeScript compiler API, which is already a devDependency (typescript ^5.7.0). No new dependency is introduced.

sql.note: src/db/migrations is an ordered, append-only migration set. The baseline records filenames and a content hash per migration so an edited applied migration is detectable as drift; it does not parse DDL.

routes.note: Exported HTTP verb handlers (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) from route.ts files, plus 'use server' action modules, recorded as the network-facing contract slice.

hooks.note: Registered by the PhanesLight plugin's own hooks/hooks.json, not merged into this project's .claude/settings.json. This project has never carried project-level PhanesLight hook entries, so there is nothing stale to remove.

mcpConsent.note: Per-item selection, not a blanket grant. serena was declined despite TypeScript being a covered language: semble already holds the code-discovery slot at two tools of schema, and the operator judged the additional symbol-navigation schema not worth its per-session cost. deepwiki was declined because this project's external dependency set is small and well-known (next, react, postgres.js, nodemailer, qrcode). Do not re-offer either without a new operator decision.

foreignAssets.note: User-authored, NEVER overwritten, regenerated or rostered by any PhanesLight run. Recorded for discovery only.

capabilities.grantedNote: Populated 2026-09-19 at the bootstrap closure review. The bootstrap left this empty while CLAUDE.md §15 named three grants, so the prose register and its machine-readable counterpart disagreed. The audit workflow's capability-register discipline audits the prose; this is the value it reconciles against. Note afldb-reviewer holds semble but NOT context7, by design — if a finding turns on external library behaviour it cannot confirm from the repository, it says so in the plan and hands that question to the orchestrator rather than guessing.

lastRun.note: HEAD at bootstrap close, BEFORE the bootstrap commit. The next update run will therefore see the bootstrap commit itself as a delta and take the full flow, which is the conservative and correct outcome.
